decision_conditions:
<p style="text-align: justify; "><span style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif;">No part of the
development hereby approved shall be occupied until evidence has been submitted
to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority confirming that the
residential development has achieved CO2 reductions in accordance with those
outlined in the energy assessment (dated 25.06.2026.
26SEC730447_34RidgwayPlace_EnergyAssesment_V1.1) and wholesome water
consumption rates of no greater than 105 litres per person per day.&nbsp;</span></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:0cm;margin-bottom:0cm;margin-top:0cm;
mso-margin-bottom-alt:8.0pt;mso-margin-top-alt:0cm;mso-add-space:auto;
text-align:justify;line-height:normal"><span style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif;">Reason: To ensure that the development achieves
a high standard of sustainability and makes efficient use of resources and to
comply with the following Development Plan policies for Merton: Policy SI2 of
the London Plan 2021 and Policies CC2.1 - 2.6 of Merton's Local Plan 2024.</span></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align:justify;line-height:normal"><span style="font-size:12.0pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif"><span style="font-size: 14px;">Tree Protection - The
development [including demolition] pursuant to this consent shall comply with
the approved Arboricultural Impact Assessment Method Statement &amp; Tree
Protection Plan (to BS:5837 2012) (Ref: TH 3085 B) dated 23</span><sup><span style="font-size: 14px;">rd</span></sup><span style="font-size: 14px;">
February 2026 unless agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The
details and measures as approved shall be retained and maintained,
until the completion of all site operations.</span></span></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align:justify;line-height:normal"><span style="font-size:12.0pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif"><span style="font-size: 14px;"><br></span></span><span style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif;">Reason:&nbsp; To protect and safeguard the
existing retained trees in accordance with the following Development
Plan policies for Merton: policy G7 of the London Plan 2021 and policies
O15.1, O15.2 and O15.4 of the Local Plan 2024.&nbsp;</span></p>

LEVEL DETACHED DWELLING WITH ASSOCIATED AMENITY SPACE, VEHICLE AND CYCLE PARKING AND REFUSE STORAGE.
